review.notes: Full word-level alignment of the OCR Markdown against extracted text from all 24 physical PDF pages; every unmatched block was inspected. Unmatched PDF text is running headers, the arXiv stamp, chart labels inside embedded figures (Figure 1-2, 4), and one page-bottom footnote restored below. Code fences (Listings 1-8) are balanced; the appended D/F proof examples keep model output inside mineru-algorithm divs and fences, so their '# Solving…' lines are not document headings. The only structural defect is the Figure 1 chart title promoted to a Markdown heading. Physical pages 1 (footnote and Figure 1 area), 2 and 7 (two reference entries) were rendered at 130-300 dpi for visual verification; the reference-URL escapes (paper\_files, 978-3-030-79876-5\_37) faithfully render the printed underscores and are kept.
